visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with brown hair, wearing a pink t-shirt and pink shorts, stands outdoors in a sunny garden. She holds a pink-to-blue gradient water bottle and a purple-to-green gradient cup. She smiles at the camera, gesturing towards the products. The background features palm trees and a white decorative carriage. (2) She holds up the pink gradient bottle, showcasing its large size and lid. She unscrews the top to reveal the wide opening while continuing to smile and speak. (3) She switches focus to the purple gradient cup, demonstrating the lid's design. She removes the small cap from the straw and clicks it into a designated slot on the side of the lid, pointing at the feature with her index finger. (4) The woman holds both items up near her face, posing with a wide smile and nodding, seemingly wrapping up her presentation in the same sunny outdoor setting.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 樂扣樂扣 不鏽鋼吸管杯 1k時開團中. [Subtitle]: 這一次樂扣樂扣出了新款式. (2) [Subtitle]: 有沒有看到我手上的漸層 超級漂亮. (3) [Subtitle]: 我手上這間呢它是800ml的水壺. (4) [Subtitle]: 所以它的容量非常的大唷. (5) [Subtitle]: 另外一款呢就是新的漸層的保溫杯. (6) [Subtitle]: 這個我也好喜歡 而且還是出漸層色. (7) [Subtitle]: 那它這次有一個小小的設計有修改. (8) [Subtitle]: 就是它吸管扣的部分. (9) [Subtitle]: 它吸管這個頭呢是可以直接拆下來的. (10) [Subtitle]: 旁邊有個小卡筍. (11) [Subtitle]: 它可以直接讓你卡在在這個上面. (12) [Subtitle]: 這樣就不用擔心你的吸管頭頭不見囉. (13) [Subtitle]: 那喝完之後呢 就再把它蓋起來就好了. (14) [Subtitle]: 其它的 一如既往表現的非常完美. (15) [Subtitle]: 就是保溫保冰效果非常好 容量也非常大. (16) [Subtitle]: 重量也很輕. (17) [Subtitle]: 所以這一次又再次開了團購跟大家分享. (18) [Subtitle]: 喜歡趕快去買哦.
